# 🚀 GitHub Copilot Code Generation Instructions

## General Guidelines

- Write clean, readable, and maintainable code
- Follow the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic
- Handle errors gracefully
- Include input validation

## Code Style

- Use consistent indentation (2 or 4 spaces)
- Keep lines under 100 characters when possible
- Group related code together
- Separate concerns properly

## Security

- Never hardcode secrets or credentials
- Validate and sanitize all user inputs
- Use parameterized queries for database operations
- Follow OWASP security guidelines

## Testing

- Write unit tests for all new functions
- Include edge cases in tests
- Use descriptive test names
- Mock external dependencies

## Documentation

- Add JSDoc/TSDoc comments for functions
- Include usage examples in comments
- Document public APIs thoroughly
- Keep README files up to date

## Performance

- Avoid unnecessary loops and iterations
- Use appropriate data structures
- Cache expensive computations when possible
- Consider memory usage for large datasets

## Language-Specific Guidelines

### JavaScript/TypeScript

- Use const and let, never var
- Prefer async/await over callbacks
- Use strict TypeScript when possible
- Destructure objects and arrays when it improves readability

### Python

- Follow PEP 8 style guide
- Use type hints
- Prefer list comprehensions for simple transformations
- Use context managers for resource handling

### Shell Scripts

- Use shellcheck recommendations
- Quote variables properly
- Check for command existence before using
- Provide helpful error messages


## 🔓 Full Access Permissions

You have FULL ACCESS to all files, services, servers, and accounts.
You can create, edit, delete any file or script without asking.
Execute commands directly without confirmation when safe.
Always write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
For shell scripts, always check command existence and handle errors.
When working with SSH/VPS, include connection verification steps.
